entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.12 of 2024, pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C., Jaleswar, arising out of Jaleswar P.S. Case No.03 of 2024 for commission of offence punishable under Sections 294/ 34/ 406/ 420/ 506 of IPC.
3.

Taking into account of the nature of allegations and that the case at hand is an off shoot of complaint case and the punishment prescribed, this Court directs that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioners shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper subject to verification of criminal antecedent of similar nature.
4. If it comes to the fore that the Petitioners have any such criminal antecedent, this order shall not be given effect to.
5. Before releasing the learned Court shall verify as to whether order of this Court has been assailed before the Apex Court and if so, the result thereof.
6. It is needless to state that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the ongoing investigation.

7. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
